summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, reporting conversions of index-linked time charters for two vessels to fixed-rate time charters at an average of approximately US$51,200 per day, gross, effective August 1 through December 31, 2026. Vessels continue earning scrubber benefits. This is a routine operational contract adjustment for an ongoing charter agreement, not a corporate special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or capital event. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary operational update for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation relevance for event-driven investors.
